articles.title: Deadly rabbit disease outbreak sweeps through snowshoe hares in Alberta
articles.description: The Alberta government is monitoring what it says is an unprecedented outbreak of rabbit hemorrhagic disease among snowshoe hares. The highly contagious viral disease doesn't harm humans, but kills nearly 90 per cent of infected rabbits and hares.

articles.title: Russia imposes quarantine after lumpy skin disease outbreak in cattle
articles.description: A quarantine has been imposed in Bolshaya Sosnovka, Krasnoyarsk Krai, after lumpy skin disease was detected in cattle. The restrictions will remain in effect until December 25, 2026.

articles.title: Bird flu confirmed in Okeechobee County, quarantine issued
articles.description: A poultry quarantine is in effect in Okeechobee County after state officials confirmed a case of highly pathogenic avian influenza, commonly known as bird flu, in a commercial chicken flock.
